hook_text: Six tables, six posters, one whole term: can you walk through the expo and answer every question?
clip_script: Upington, on the banks of the Orange River. The school hall is full of posters and models for the end-of-year expo. Table one: a glass of water and a diary of daily uses. Table two: a model of the water cycle with cotton-wool clouds. Table three: a clay pot, a bucket, a tank and a dam. Table four: a model borehole and a tap. Table five: a letter, a typewriter and an old telephone. Table six: a laptop on a video call. Revision time!
visual_style: Whiteboard plan of a school hall with six numbered tables, each with a tiny drawing: a glass, a water cycle, a dam, a borehole and tap, a typewriter and telephone, and a laptop.
mood: Proud and confident, like showing off your best work.
pacing: One table per beat, quick and clear, then the pocket summary.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and make a mini revision poster for one table.
